title: EntityV0
description: Common envelope shared by every knowledge-schema-v0 entity, regardless of type. type/payload form a discriminated union: tank_v0 payloads are validated against tank.schema.json, shape_v0 payloads against shape.schema.json, and unknown_entity payloads against the UnknownEntityPayload $def below. Tank and Shape intentionally share only this envelope, not a common payload shape -- see tank.schema.json/shape.schema.json for why. Upgrade/variant relationships between entities are NOT embedded here; they live as external relation.schema.json edges referencing an entity's id.

UnknownEntityPayload.description: Escape hatch for source pages that are clearly knowledge entities but whose source structure does not fit an approved typed family (tank_v0, shape_v0) -- e.g. Dominator's multiple per-variant infoboxes and non-numeric hedged tier ('Supposedly 6'), which would violate tank_v0's single-infobox/integer-tier assumptions. Identity and provenance are already carried by the common envelope; this payload only adds a place for why the page didn't fit, plus raw/sparse evidence, without pretending to understand structure this schema slice does not model.

reason.description: Free-text note on why this page could not be modeled as an approved typed family, when known (e.g. 'multiple per-tank-variant infoboxes on one page' or 'non-numeric tier field').

raw_evidence.description: Sparse bag of raw field name/value pairs observed on the source page, preserved verbatim without interpretation.

schema_version.description: Schema version this entity document was written against.

id.description: Stable identifier for this entity, unique within the knowledge corpus. Format/allocation is out of scope for this schema slice.

type.description: Discriminates which schema payload must apply -- see properties.payload.

name.description: Primary display name, e.g. as it appears as the source wiki page title.

aliases.description: Alternate names/spellings this entity is also known by (e.g. redirect page titles). Optional; most entities have none.

entity_status.description: Whether this entity currently exists in the live game, was removed, or status could not be determined from the source. Reuses the same active/removed/unknown vocabulary as relation.schema.json's status for consistency.

source_domain.description: Heuristic, evidence-backed classification of the source page's domain. 'canonical_candidate' is deliberately not named 'canonical' -- it is never equated with verified canonical truth, only a candidate supported by classification signals.

payload.description: Typed payload, narrowed by the type/payload discriminated union below according to the 'type' field.
